[Severyn Khomych]{.cv-name}

### Education

**University of Vienna**, 2024 – 2027 (expected)\
BSc Mathematics. Bachelor's thesis: *Observation and Control of Agent and Density Models*, supervised by Prof. Angelika Manhart.

**The University of Hong Kong**, 2026 – 2027\
Exchange year, Department of Mathematics.

### Research

**MIT PRIMES**, Oct 2023 – Aug 2024\
Lie theory and quantum groups, mentored by Prof. Alexander Tsymbaliuk (Purdue University). Paper [1].

**MIT Yulia's Dream**, Jun 2022 – Jun 2023\
Algebraic combinatorics, research group led by Prof. Darij Grinberg (Drexel University). Preprints [2], [3].

### Papers

[1] S. Khomych, N. Korniichuk, K. Molokanov, A. Tsymbaliuk. Standard Lyndon loop words: weighted orders. *International Mathematics Research Notices* 2025(5), 1–32. [doi:10.1093/imrn/rnaf030](https://doi.org/10.1093/imrn/rnaf030)

[2] D. Grinberg, N. Korniichuk, K. Molokanov, S. Khomych. The diagonal derivative of a skew Schur polynomial. Preprint, 2024. [arXiv:2402.14217](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14217)

[3] D. Grinberg, N. Korniichuk, K. Molokanov, S. Khomych. The Pak–Postnikov and Naruse skew hook length formulas: a new proof. Preprint, 2023. [arXiv:2310.18275](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18275)

### Scholarship and teaching

**IV-MINT Scholarship for High Potentials**, Federation of Austrian Industries, 2025

**Arduino and Microelectronics Workshop**, 2025\
Organiser, with the Federation of Austrian Industries, the University of Vienna and Aerospace Team Graz. A hands-on microcontroller course; each participant built a hardware project programmed in C++.
